title: Intel Capital invests in Figure's $1B+ Series C

sources.quote: The round was led by Parkway Venture Capital with significant investment from Brookfield Asset Management, NVIDIA, Macquarie Capital, Intel Capital, Align Ventures, Tamarack Global, LG Technology Ventures, Salesforce, T-Mobile Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures.

explain: Intel Capital put an undisclosed amount into humanoid-robot maker Figure's Series C, which raised more than $1 billion at a $39 billion valuation.
